entry.name: zl.union
entry.digest: Combine two lists without duplicating shared items
entry.description: zl.union accepts a list in both inlets and sends a list out the left outlet that contains the contents of both input lists. The output does not duplicate items in the right list that are in the left list.

arguments.name: initial-list
arguments.description: Sets the initial right input list.
